answer: The 1918 influenza pandemic death toll is estimated between 15-17.4 million deaths globally according to more recent scholarly research, though older estimates cited 50-100 million deaths. For the United States specifically, approximately 675,000 people died. The wide range in estimates reflects differences in historical data availability, estimation methodologies, and which years are included in the count (1918 only vs 1918-1920). More recent research using controlled statistical approaches tends to produce the lower estimates.
